zh.text: $MAGS Mag7 ETF強勁，接近大型MACD買入觸發突破。如果NVDA在此消息見底且其他Mag7持續強勢，將進一步支持年底反彈。巨型科技股亦受惠於較高利率，因其擁有數十億現金賺取5%利率。

en.text: $MAGS Mag7 ETF strong and nearing a big MACD buy trigger breakout. If NVDA bottoms with this news and other Mag7 continue strength, it further supports year-end rally case. Mega tech benefit from higher rates as they have billions in cash earning 5%.

zh.text: Stephanie Link指出本週因$NVDA和熱通膨而波動劇烈。然而GDP達3.5%令人鼓舞，EPS上漲28%。未來一週有零售EPS值得關注。

en.text: Stephanie Link notes a wild week with $NVDA and hot inflation. Yet GDP at 3.5% is encouraging, and EPS up 28%. Big week ahead with retail EPS.

zh.text: 相對國債僅多一點點收益率卻承擔重大下行風險，這不是補償，而是自滿。$JOJO提供更聰明的信用投資方法。

en.text: A sliver of extra yield over Treasuries for significant downside risk is not compensation, that is complacency. $JOJO offers a smarter approach to credit.

zh.text: 突發：美元延續漲幅+0.3%至新周期高位。我們在$UUP方面保持多頭。

en.text: BREAKING: The U.S. Dollar extends gains +0.3% to new Cycle Highs. We remain long in $UUP terms.

zh.text: 油價因地緣政治風險飆升。關稅不確定性無處不在。衰退機率上升。$JOJO 尊重信號，而非敘事。

en.text: Oil prices surging on geopolitical risk. Tariff uncertainty everywhere. Recession odds climbing. $JOJO respects the signal, not the narrative.

zh.text: 自由市場ETF（$FMKT）今日收盤於21.08美元，下跌0.18%。即使今日微跌，FMKT仍是市場上唯一專注於從去監管環境中捕捉價值的ETF。

en.text: The Free Markets ETF ($FMKT) ended trading at $21.08 today, down 0.18%. Even with today's slight dip, FMKT remains the market's only ETF focused on capturing value from deregulatory environments.

zh.text: 市場測試了$JOJO。它也測試了我。我們仍然在這裡。宏觀設置正與論點一致。如果你曾經考慮過信用輪換，現在可能是時候了。

en.text: The market tested $JOJO. It tested me. We're still here. And the macro setup is aligning with the thesis. If you've ever considered credit rotation, now may be the time.
